_readme: Hand-checked official values applied on top of the datasets when they lag. Every entry names its source. Edit with care.

weapons.name: Coda Bubonico
weapons.source: WARFRAME Wiki: "The Coda Bubonico uses Shotgun Mods." (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Coda_Bubonico), confirmed in-game 2026-10-17 with Primed Point Blank and Galvanized Hell equipped
weapons.attackSource: WARFRAME Wiki attack table lists Multishot 1 for Burst and Radial Attack (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Coda_Bubonico); in-game arsenal 2026-10-17 shows the Burst total at 2.1x its per-pellet sum with Galvanized Hell (+110%)
weapons.batterySource: WARFRAME Wiki https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Coda_Bubonico: regenerates 9 ammo/s, 1.5s delay, 0.1s when emptied; reload speed only affects the delay (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Battery_Weapon)
